messages:
emma: CloudPort reported multiple AWS marketplace usage lines imported as 'unattributed' for 2026-03-05 to 2026-03-07. They say BuyerReference contains partner account id.
raj: Do we have sample rows? We need to see BuyerReference vs expected downstream tag.
emma: Sample from their CSV attached to ticket. Snip:
```
TxId,Start,End,BuyerReference,Product,Quantity,Cost
x-100,2026-03-05,2026-03-05,cloudport-master-321,redwood-llm,2400,48.00
```
fin-ops: If unmapped this will show as unattributed usage on customer billing. We need to compute impacted downstream customers and issue provisional credits.
partner-ops: CloudPort says a mapping export switched to partner-level reporting after a config change on 2026-03-04. They provided a downstream mapping file for Mar5-7.
emma: Action items: (1) Eng to add fallback to use partner mapping file when BuyerReference matches known partner pattern. (2) Finance to prepare provisional credit CSV once mapping is ingested. (3) Partner to re-run export and provide backfill if needed.
raj: Eng can do a 48hr hotfix to reference partner mapping S3 artifact for the date window. I'll add validation to fail ingestion if >3% daily usage is unmapped.
fin-ops: Finance needs CSV format: downstream_customer_id, affected_cost, invoice_period, partner_ref, original_tx_count. We'll mark credits 'provisional'.
partner-ops: CloudPort confirmed they will re-export and uploaded mapping file to ticket evidence. They also approved provisional PO for credits.
billing-bot: audit: ticket-6281 created; mapping uploaded to /evidence/ticket-6281/ at 2026-03-11T09:12:03Z.
emma: Keeping thread open until re-export processed and credits issued. Linking JIRA BILL-6281 for follow-ups.
